qpq_ui_fill_land_t_effect = {
	scope:qpq_deal_me = {
		every_held_title = {
			limit = {
				tier >= tier_county
				NOT = { this = scope:qpq_deal_me.capital_county }
				NOT = { this = scope:qpq_deal_me.primary_title }
			}
			add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_land_t
		}
	}
	ordered_in_list = {
		list = qpq_ui_pool_land_t
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_land target = prev } }
			}
		}
		order_by = qpq_ui_title_order_value
		max = 120
		check_range_bounds = no
		scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_land_candidates target = prev } }
	}
}

qpq_ui_clear_leg_t_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_pick_char
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_title }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_title
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_artifact }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_artifact
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_armed }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_armed
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_consent }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_consent
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_armies }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_armies
	}
}

qpq_ui_leg_t_refresh_effect = {
	qpq_ui_prune_goods_t_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_ui_leg_t_allows_land_trigger = yes }
		qpq_ui_fill_land_t_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_t_kind = flag:none } }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_ekind value = var:qpq_ui_t_kind }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { qpq_ui_leg_t_has_goods_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_ekind value = flag:barter }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_ekind }
		qpq_ui_clear_scopes_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_ekind = flag:chartered_conquest }
			qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
			scope:recipient = {
				every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { this = scope:actor }
						NOT = { this = scope:actor.top_liege }
						NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				save_temporary_scope_as = secondary_recipient
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:secondary_recipient = {
							is_landed = yes
							NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
						}
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t
				order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
				max = 120
				check_range_bounds = no
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = prev } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				clear_saved_scope = secondary_recipient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:target }
				clear_saved_scope = target
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
				if = {
					limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char = { is_in_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t } }
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char } }
						}
						add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
					}
				}
				else = {
					remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_pick_char
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
				var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
			}
			qpq_ui_load_goods_t_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_target value = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_term value = 96 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_payer_tier value = qpq_chartered_conquest_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_agent_tier value = qpq_chartered_conquest_agent_tier_value }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_chartered_conquest_price_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_ask value = qpq_chartered_conquest_ask_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers value = qpq_chartered_conquest_offer_points_value }
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_t_a_other
				value = {
					value = qpq_chartered_conquest_ai_acceptance_value
					subtract = qpq_chartered_conquest_ask_value
					subtract = qpq_chartered_conquest_offer_points_value
					subtract = {
						value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
						multiply = 0.5
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land }
				change_variable = {
					name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers
					add = {
						value = qpq_offer_land_points_value
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_t_value
						multiply = 1
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:secondary_recipient

					scope:secondary_recipient = {
						is_landed = yes
						NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
					}
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_ok
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_ekind = flag:sanctioned_conquest }
			qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
			scope:recipient = {
				every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { this = scope:actor }
						NOT = { this = scope:actor.top_liege }
						NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				save_temporary_scope_as = secondary_recipient
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:secondary_recipient = {
							is_landed = yes
							NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
						}
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t
				order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
				max = 120
				check_range_bounds = no
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = prev } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				clear_saved_scope = secondary_recipient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:target }
				clear_saved_scope = target
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
				if = {
					limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char = { is_in_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t } }
					if = {
						limit = {

					type = rival
					limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				}
				every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
					limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				}
				every_vassal = {
					limit = {
						is_landed = yes
						NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				save_temporary_scope_as = secondary_recipient
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = scope:secondary_recipient
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t
				order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
				max = 120
				check_range_bounds = no
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = prev } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				clear_saved_scope = secondary_recipient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:target }
				clear_saved_scope = target
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
				if = {
					limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char = { is_in_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t } }
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char } }
						}
						add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
					}
				}
				else = {
					remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_pick_char
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
				var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
			}
			qpq_ui_load_goods_t_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_target value = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_term value = 12 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_payer_tier value = qpq_favourable_omens_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_agent_tier value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_favourable_omens_price_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_ask value = qpq_favourable_omens_ask_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers value = qpq_favourable_omens_offer_points_value }
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_t_a_other
				value = {
					value = qpq_favourable_omens_ai_acceptance_value
					subtract = qpq_favourable_omens_ask_value
					subtract = qpq_favourable_omens_offer_points_value
					subtract = {
						value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
						multiply = 0.5
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land }
				change_variable = {
					name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers
					add = {
						value = qpq_offer_land_points_value
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_t_value
						multiply = 1
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:secondary_recipient
					exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_ok
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_ekind = flag:consecration_rites }
			qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
			qpq_ui_load_goods_t_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_term value = 12 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_payer_tier value = qpq_consecration_rites_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_agent_tier value = qpq_consecration_rites_agent_tier_value }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_consecration_rites_price_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_ask value = qpq_consecration_rites_ask_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers value = qpq_consecration_rites_offer_points_value }
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_t_a_other
				value = {
					value = qpq_consecration_rites_ai_acceptance_value
					subtract = qpq_consecration_rites_ask_value
					subtract = qpq_consecration_rites_offer_points_value
					subtract = {
						value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
						multiply = 0.5
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land }
				change_variable = {
					name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers
					add = {
						value = qpq_offer_land_points_value
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_t_value
						multiply = 1
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_ok
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_ekind = flag:temple_patronage }
			qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
			scope:actor = {
				every_relation = {
					type = rival
					limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				}
				every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
					limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				}
				every_vassal = {
					limit = {
						is_landed = yes
						NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				save_temporary_scope_as = secondary_recipient
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = scope:secondary_recipient
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t
				order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
				max = 120
				check_range_bounds = no
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = prev } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				clear_saved_scope = secondary_recipient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:target }
				clear_saved_scope = target
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
				if = {
					limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char = { is_in_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t } }
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char } }
						}
						add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
					}
				}
				else = {
					remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_pick_char
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
				var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
			}
			qpq_ui_load_goods_t_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_target value = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_term value = 12 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_payer_tier value = qpq_temple_patronage_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_agent_tier value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_temple_patronage_price_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_ask value = qpq_temple_patronage_ask_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers value = qpq_temple_patronage_offer_points_value }
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_t_a_other
				value = {
					value = qpq_temple_patronage_ai_acceptance_value
					subtract = qpq_temple_patronage_ask_value
					subtract = qpq_temple_patronage_offer_points_value
					subtract = {
						value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
						multiply = 0.5
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land }
				change_variable = {
					name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers
					add = {
						value = qpq_offer_land_points_value
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_t_value
						multiply = 1
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:secondary_recipient
					exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_ok
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_ekind = flag:barter }
			qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
			qpq_ui_load_goods_t_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_term value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_payer_tier value = qpq_barter_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_agent_tier value = qpq_barter_agent_tier_value }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_barter_price_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_ask value = qpq_barter_ask_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers value = qpq_barter_offer_points_value }
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_t_a_other
				value = {
					value = qpq_barter_ai_acceptance_value
					subtract = qpq_barter_ask_value
					subtract = qpq_barter_offer_points_value
					subtract = {
						value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor)"
						multiply = 0.5
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land }
				change_variable = {
					name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers
					add = {
						value = qpq_offer_land_points_value
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_t_value
						multiply = 1
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_ok
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_load_goods_i_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_gold_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_gold value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_land_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_land value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_claim
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_claim_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_claim value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_office
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_office_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_office value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_marriage
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_marriage_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_marriage value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_release_hook
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_release_hook_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_release_hook value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_my_word
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_my_word_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_my_word value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_secret
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_secret_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_secret value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_contract
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_contract_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_contract value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_succession
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_succession_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_succession value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_clemency

		}

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_arms
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_arms_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_arms value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_artifact
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_artifact_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_artifact value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_church
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_church_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_church value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_restraint
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_restraint_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_restraint value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_hook
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_hook_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_hook value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
			var:qpq_ui_i_timing ?= flag:on_delivery
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_on_delivery_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_on_delivery value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
			var:qpq_ui_i_timing ?= flag:split
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_split_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_split value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
			var:qpq_ui_i_timing ?= flag:stipend
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_stipend_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_stipend value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_armed
			qpq_ui_leg_i_has_extra_qpq_x_armed_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_x_armed value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_consent

	if = {

		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_x_armies value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_charter }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_charter value = yes }
	}
}

qpq_ui_prune_goods_i_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_gold_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_land_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_claim
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_claim_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_claim
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_office
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_office_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_office
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_marriage
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_marriage_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_marriage
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_release_hook
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_release_hook_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_release_hook
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_my_word
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_my_word_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_my_word
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_secret
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_secret_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_secret
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_contract
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_contract_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_contract
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_succession
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_succession_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_succession
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_clemency
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_clemency_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_clemency
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_arms
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_arms_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_arms
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_artifact
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_artifact_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_artifact
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_church
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_church_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_church
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_restraint
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_restraint_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_restraint
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_hook
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_hook_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_hook
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land }
			has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_land
		}
		clear_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_land
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold } }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_timing value = flag:up_front }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:qpq_ui_i_timing = flag:on_delivery
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_on_delivery_trigger = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_timing value = flag:up_front }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:qpq_ui_i_timing = flag:split
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_split_trigger = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_timing value = flag:up_front }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:qpq_ui_i_timing = flag:stipend
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_stipend_trigger = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_timing value = flag:up_front }
	}
}

qpq_ui_fill_land_i_effect = {
	scope:qpq_deal_them = {
		every_held_title = {
			limit = {
				tier >= tier_county
				NOT = { this = scope:qpq_deal_them.capital_county }
				NOT = { this = scope:qpq_deal_them.primary_title }
			}
			add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_land_i
		}
	}
	ordered_in_list = {
		list = qpq_ui_pool_land_i
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_land target = prev } }
			}
		}
		order_by = qpq_ui_title_order_value
		max = 120
		check_range_bounds = no
		scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_land_candidates target = prev } }
	}
}

qpq_ui_clear_leg_i_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_pick_char
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_title }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_title
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_artifact }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_artifact
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_armed }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_armed
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_consent }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_consent
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_armies }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_armies
	}
}

qpq_ui_leg_i_refresh_effect = {
	qpq_ui_prune_goods_i_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_land_trigger = yes }
		qpq_ui_fill_land_i_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_i_kind = flag:none } }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_ekind value = var:qpq_ui_i_kind }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { qpq_ui_leg_i_has_goods_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_ekind value = flag:barter }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_ekind }
		qpq_ui_clear_scopes_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_ekind = flag:chartered_conquest }
			qpq_deal_orient_swapped_effect = yes
			scope:recipient = {
				every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { this = scope:actor }
						NOT = { this = scope:actor.top_liege }
						NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				save_temporary_scope_as = secondary_recipient
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:secondary_recipient = {
							is_landed = yes
							NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
						}
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i
				order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
				max = 120
				check_range_bounds = no
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = prev } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				clear_saved_scope = secondary_recipient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:target }
				clear_saved_scope = target
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
				if = {
					limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char = { is_in_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i } }
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char } }
						}
						add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
					}
				}
				else = {
					remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_pick_char
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
				var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_target value = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_term value = 96 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_payer_tier value = qpq_chartered_conquest_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_agent_tier value = qpq_chartered_conquest_agent_tier_value }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_chartered_conquest_price_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			set_variable = {

				value = {
					value = qpq_chartered_conquest_demand_value
					multiply = -0.6
				}
			}
			set_variable = {

				value = {
					value = qpq_chartered_conquest_offer_points_value
					multiply = -0.8
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_other value = 0 }

					name = qpq_ui_i_a_offers
					add = {
						value = qpq_offer_land_points_value
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_i_value
						multiply = -0.8
					}
				}
			}
			if = {

					scope:secondary_recipient = {

						NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
					}
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_ok
			}
		}

			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_payer_tier value = qpq_pliant_patriarch_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_agent_tier value = qpq_pliant_patriarch_agent_tier_value }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_pliant_patriarch_price_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_i_a_ask
				value = {
					value = qpq_pliant_patriarch_demand_value
					multiply = -0.6
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_i_a_offers
				value = {
					value = qpq_pliant_patriarch_offer_points_value
					multiply = -0.8
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_other value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land }
				change_variable = {
					name = qpq_ui_i_a_offers
					add = {
						value = qpq_offer_land_points_value
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_i_value
						multiply = -0.8
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_ok
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_ekind = flag:favourable_omens }
			qpq_deal_orient_swapped_effect = yes
			scope:actor = { add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_i }

			scope:actor = {
				every_relation = {
					type = rival
					limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				}
				every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
					limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				}
				every_vassal = {
					limit = {
						is_landed = yes
						NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				save_temporary_scope_as = secondary_recipient
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = scope:secondary_recipient
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i
				order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
				max = 120
				check_range_bounds = no
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = prev } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				clear_saved_scope = secondary_recipient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:target }
				clear_saved_scope = target
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
				if = {
					limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char = { is_in_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i } }
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char } }
						}
						add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
					}
				}
				else = {
					remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_pick_char
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
				var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
			}
			qpq_ui_load_goods_i_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_target value = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_term value = 12 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_payer_tier value = qpq_favourable_omens_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_agent_tier value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_favourable_omens_price_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_i_a_ask
				value = {
					value = qpq_favourable_omens_demand_value
					multiply = -0.6
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_i_a_offers
				value = {
					value = qpq_favourable_omens_offer_points_value
					multiply = -0.8
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_other value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land }
				change_variable = {
					name = qpq_ui_i_a_offers
					add = {
						value = qpq_offer_land_points_value
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_i_value
						multiply = -0.8
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:secondary_recipient
					exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_ok
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_ekind = flag:consecration_rites }
			qpq_deal_orient_swapped_effect = yes
			qpq_ui_load_goods_i_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_term value = 12 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_payer_tier value = qpq_consecration_rites_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_agent_tier value = qpq_consecration_rites_agent_tier_value }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_consecration_rites_price_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_i_a_ask
				value = {
					value = qpq_consecration_rites_demand_value
					multiply = -0.6
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_i_a_offers
				value = {
					value = qpq_consecration_rites_offer_points_value
					multiply = -0.8
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_other value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land }
				change_variable = {
					name = qpq_ui_i_a_offers
					add = {
						value = qpq_offer_land_points_value
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_i_value
						multiply = -0.8
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_ok
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_ekind = flag:temple_patronage }
			qpq_deal_orient_swapped_effect = yes
			scope:actor = {
				every_relation = {
					type = rival
					limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				}
				every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
					limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				}
				every_vassal = {
					limit = {
						is_landed = yes
						NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				save_temporary_scope_as = secondary_recipient
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = scope:secondary_recipient
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i
				order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
				max = 120
				check_range_bounds = no
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = prev } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				clear_saved_scope = secondary_recipient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:target }
				clear_saved_scope = target
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
				if = {
					limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char = { is_in_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i } }
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char } }
						}
						add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
					}
				}
				else = {
					remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_pick_char
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
				var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
			}
			qpq_ui_load_goods_i_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_target value = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_term value = 12 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_payer_tier value = qpq_temple_patronage_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_agent_tier value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_temple_patronage_price_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_i_a_ask
				value = {
					value = qpq_temple_patronage_demand_value
					multiply = -0.6
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_i_a_offers
				value = {
					value = qpq_temple_patronage_offer_points_value
					multiply = -0.8
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_other value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land }
				change_variable = {
					name = qpq_ui_i_a_offers
					add = {
						value = qpq_offer_land_points_value
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_i_value
						multiply = -0.8
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:secondary_recipient
					exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_ok
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_ekind = flag:barter }
			qpq_deal_orient_swapped_effect = yes
			qpq_ui_load_goods_i_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_term value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_payer_tier value = qpq_barter_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_agent_tier value = qpq_barter_agent_tier_value }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_barter_price_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_i_a_ask
				value = {
					value = qpq_barter_demand_value
					multiply = -0.6
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_i_a_offers
				value = {
					value = qpq_barter_offer_points_value
					multiply = -0.8
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_other value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land }
				change_variable = {
					name = qpq_ui_i_a_offers
					add = {
						value = qpq_offer_land_points_value
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_i_value
						multiply = -0.8
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_ok
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_deal_finish_effect = {
	qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_ask value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_offers value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_other value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_ekind }
		set_variable = qpq_ui_deal_active
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_ask add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_ask }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_offers add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_offers }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_other add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_other }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_ekind }
		set_variable = qpq_ui_deal_active
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_ask add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_ask }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_offers add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_offers }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_other add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_other }
	}
	change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_other add = qpq_ui_deal_opinion_value }
	set_variable = {
		name = qpq_ui_acc_total
		value = {
			value = var:qpq_ui_acc_ask
			add = var:qpq_ui_acc_offers
			add = var:qpq_ui_acc_other
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_deal_active }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_my_tier value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_their_tier value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_ekind }
			if = {
				limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_payer_tier > var:qpq_ui_my_tier }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_my_tier value = var:qpq_ui_t_payer_tier }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_agent_tier > var:qpq_ui_their_tier }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_their_tier value = var:qpq_ui_t_agent_tier }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_ekind }
			if = {
				limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_agent_tier > var:qpq_ui_my_tier }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_my_tier value = var:qpq_ui_i_agent_tier }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_payer_tier > var:qpq_ui_their_tier }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_their_tier value = var:qpq_ui_i_payer_tier }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:qpq_ui_my_tier <= 0
				var:qpq_ui_their_tier <= 0
			}
			set_variable = qpq_ui_charter_ok
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_charter_ok }
					NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_charter }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:qpq_ui_my_tier < 1 }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_my_tier value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:qpq_ui_their_tier < 1 }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_their_tier value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_clear_choices_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_charter }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_charter
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_pick_char
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_title }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_title
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_artifact }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_artifact
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_gold }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_gold
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_claim }

	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_office }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_office
	}

		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_target_title }
			var:qpq_ui_i_target_title = { save_scope_as = qpq_deal_i_title }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_target_artifact }
			var:qpq_ui_i_target_artifact = { save_scope_as = qpq_deal_i_artifact }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_target }
			var:qpq_ui_i_target = { save_scope_as = qpq_deal_i_target }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_deal_land_i }
			clear_variable_list = qpq_deal_land_i
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_land }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = qpq_ui_i_land
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_deal_land_i target = prev } }
			}
		}
	}
}

		clear_saved_scope = qpq_land_leg
	}

	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_land_leg value = flag:t }

		limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind ?= flag:chartered_conquest }
		qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes

			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_deal_t_char }
			scope:qpq_deal_t_char = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }

qpq_deal_load_goods_i_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_o_gold ?= yes }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_gold value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_o_land ?= yes }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_land value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_o_claim ?= yes }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_claim value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_o_office ?= yes }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_office value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_o_marriage ?= yes }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_marriage value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_o_release_hook ?= yes }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_release_hook value = yes }
